types.doc: Generic Error: Dynamic string payload (human-readable error message).
types.name: GENERIC_ERROR

types.doc: GPS Data: 3 × float32 elements (latitude, longitude, altitude).
types.name: GPS_DATA

types.doc: Gyro Data: 3 × float32 elements (x, y, z). Logged only to GroundStation.
types.name: GYRO_DATA

types.doc: Accel Data: 3 × float32 elements (x, y, z). Logged only to GroundStation.
types.name: ACCEL_DATA

types.doc: Battery Voltage: 1 × float32 element.
types.name: BATTERY_VOLTAGE

types.doc: Battery Current: 1 × float32 element.
types.name: BATTERY_CURRENT

types.doc: Barometer Data: 3 × float32 elements (alt, prs, tmp). Logged only to GroundStation.
types.name: BAROMETER_DATA

types.doc: Abort: Dynamic string payload (reason / code / message).
types.name: ABORT

types.doc: Fuel Flow: 1 × float32 element.
types.name: FUEL_FLOW

types.doc: Valve Command: 1 × uint8 element (command).
types.name: VALVE_COMMAND

types.doc: Flight Command: 1 × uint8 element (command).
types.name: FLIGHT_COMMAND

types.doc: Ox Tank Pressure: 1 × float32 element (psi). The valve board's oxidiser tank PT.
types.name: OX_TANK_PRESSURE

types.doc: Legacy name of OX_TANK_PRESSURE (the same oxidiser tank PT). Kept so older valve-board firmware, SD cards and recordings still decode; the station records and displays it as OX_TANK_PRESSURE.
types.name: FUEL_TANK_PRESSURE

types.doc: Flight State: 1 \u00d7 uint8 element.
types.name: FLIGHT_STATE

types.doc: Heartbeat: No payload.
types.name: HEARTBEAT

types.doc: Warning: Dynamic string payload (human-readable warning text).
types.name: WARNING

types.doc: Message Data: Dynamic string payload (free-form log message).
types.name: MESSAGE_DATA

types.doc: Commands to be sent to the actuator board (1 u8)
types.name: ACTUATOR_COMMAND

types.doc: The status of the umbilical setup (valves, actuator position, ingnighter state, etc)(2 u8's valve, position)
types.name: UMBILICAL_STATUS

types.doc: 1000kg loadcell values (1 float32)
types.name: KG1000

types.doc: 50kg Loadcell (1 float32)
types.name: KG50

types.doc: (1 x U8) The number of satelites the gps sees in the sky.
types.name: GPS_SATELLITE_NUMBER

types.doc: RF GPS status, 4 x f32: state (0 no module, 1 silent, 2 no fix, 3 fix), satellites, s since last byte, s since last fix (-1 never).
types.name: GPS_STATUS

types.doc: Initial condition euler angles: 3 x float32 values.
types.name: EULER_ANGLES

types.doc: Ordered Message: MessageData variant for responses to manual commands and critical state changes.
types.name: ORDERED_MESSAGE

types.doc: Ascent State: Quaternion vector (4 x 1 x float32) and shared state (2 x 1 x float32). Logged only to GroundStation.
types.name: ASCENT_STATE

types.doc: Descent State: low pass coordinates (2 x 1 x float32) and shared state (2 x 1 x float32). Logged only to GroundStation.
types.name: DESCENT_STATE

types.doc: Ascent Biases: pre-launch command to update biases of Ascent KF (4 x float32).
types.name: ASCENT_BIASES

types.doc: Gyro Data: 3 × float32 elements (x, y, z). Logged only to SD.
types.name: GYRO_LOCAL

types.doc: Accel Data: 3 × float32 elements (x, y, z). Logged only to SD.
types.name: ACCEL_LOCAL

types.doc: Accel and Gyro Data: 6 × float32 elements (ax, ay, az, gx, gy, gz). Logged only to GroundStation.
types.name: IMU_DATA

types.doc: Accel and Gyro Data: 6 × float32 elements (ax, ay, az, gx, gy, gz). Logged only to SD.
types.name: IMU_LOCAL

types.doc: Launch site: lat_deg, lon_deg, alt_msl_m (3 x float32). Station to FC before Launch; the FC echoes the site it uses. Centre of the FC's GPS acceptance window.
types.name: LAUNCH_SITE

types.doc: Integrated ground test: replayed sensor sample or estimator output computed from replayed data. 8 x float32: kind (1 IMU, 2 barometer, 3 GPS, 4 ascent state, 5 descent state), seconds since the FC accepted Launch, then that kind's values (zero padded). Logged only to GroundStation.
types.name: SIM_SAMPLE

types.doc: Barometer Data: 3 × float32 elements (alt, prs, tmp). Logged only to SD.
types.name: BAROMETER_LOCAL

types.doc: Ascent State: Quaternion vector (4 x 1 x float32) and shared state (2 x 1 x float32). Logged only to SD.
types.name: ASCENT_LOCAL

types.doc: Descent State: low pass coordinates (2 x 1 x float32) and shared state (2 x 1 x float32). Logged only to SD.
types.name: DESCENT_LOCAL

types.doc: Persistent avionics-bay underglow network variable (0 off, 1 on).
types.name: AV_BAY_UNDERGLOW

types.doc: Persistent Flight Computer buzzer network variable (0 off, 1 on).
types.name: FLIGHT_BUZZER

types.doc: Reserved legacy rate ID; telemetry rates are compile-time board settings.
types.name: RESERVED_135

types.doc: Reserved legacy rate ID; telemetry rates are compile-time board settings.
types.name: RESERVED_136

types.doc: DAQ calibration [KG1000 slope, KG1000 intercept, IADC slope, IADC intercept].
types.name: DAQ_LOADCELL_CALIBRATION

types.doc: KG50 calibration [c0,c1,c2,c3,c4,x0,tare]; kg=sum(ci*(raw-x0)^i)-tare.
types.name: DAQ_KG50_CALIBRATION

types.doc: Retained DAQ session ID and T+20s close deadline, two little-endian u64 values; zeros reset recording.
types.name: DAQ_LOG_CLOCK

types.doc: MCP3564R die temperature in Celsius; NaN means unavailable.
types.name: DAQ_ADC_TEMPERATURE

types.doc: Raw offset compensation [KG1000 reference C, raw/C, KG50 reference C, raw/C]. Subtract slope*(T-reference) before mass calibration.
types.name: DAQ_THERMAL_CALIBRATION

types.doc: Load-cell low-pass time constants [KG1000 ms, KG50 ms]; 0 disables, maximum 2000 ms.
types.name: DAQ_FILTER_CALIBRATION

types.doc: SAR_IN1..8 connector volts, nominal 3.3V reference; NaN unavailable.
types.name: DAQ_SAR_VOLTAGES

types.doc: MCP CH2,CH3,CH4,CH5,HVAIN1(CH6),HVAIN2(CH7) connector volts; HVAIN includes 11x divider; NaN unavailable/stale.
types.name: DAQ_SDADC_VOLTAGES

types.doc: J7 volts, J8 volts, J7 amps, J8 amps. TMCS1108A1B nominal midpoint zero and 50mV/A.
types.name: DAQ_CURRENT_SENSE

types.doc: VMON ADC volts, IMON ADC volts, VMAIN volts, input amps. Nominal component scaling; low-current IMON is approximate.
types.name: DAQ_POWER_MONITOR

types.doc: Managed source: 0 AMP2/CH1, 1 P6 differential CH2-CH3. Selected input uses the fast scan.
types.name: DAQ_KG50_INPUT

types.doc: [source, raw] for selected alternate KG50 input; source 1 is P6 CH2-CH3 volts. Source tag prevents mixing input calibrations.
types.name: DAQ_KG50_SELECTED

types.doc: Version 1 board diagnostics: 24 uint32 fields; optional capabilities, uptime clock, reset, allocator, transport and storage counters.
types.name: BOARD_HEALTH

types.doc: One KG1000 network slot: [uncalibrated KG1000, OMEGA PX309-1KG5V chamber psig (connector V * 200), chamber connector volts]. Only fresh assigned pressure; no extra packet slot.
types.name: DAQ_LOADCELL_CHAMBER

types.doc: DAQ live input faults (v3: ADC over-range now/latched/counters, VDDA, applied MCP3564R reference; v2: noise/drift, excitation, frame-engine counters); layout in daq_input_health.rs. Warnings only.
types.name: DAQ_INPUT_HEALTH

types.doc: DAQ-only SD status companion: flags, write/flush ages, init stage/retry count, accepted/completed retry tokens and init failures; ages UINT32_MAX mean never.
types.name: DAQ_SD_HEALTH

types.doc: One-shot nonzero manual SD reinitialization token; never a retained variable or a format request.
types.name: DAQ_SD_RETRY

types.doc: DAQ SD application acknowledgement: actual session/deadline and accepted clock revision as low/high UInt32 pairs, followed by storage flags; independent from transport delivery.
types.name: DAQ_LAUNCH_LOG_STATUS

types.doc: GS-only DAQ DAC signal generator command v2, exact 48 LE bytes (DAQ-Board docs/dac-waveforms.md): version, channel (0xFF all, disable only), enable, waveform 0-8, amplitude/offset/frequency f32 (DAC-pin volts, Hz), steps u16, lease_ms u16, dwell_ms u32, nonzero sequence u32, phase/duty Q16, chirp stop f32 and sweep ms, arbitrary table CRC-32 and length, flags, reserved. Level-triggered lease keepalive; enable only in Startup/Idle.
types.name: DAQ_DAC_COMMAND

types.doc: DAQ DAC signal generator status v2, exact 136 LE bytes: version, DAQ flight state, gate, flags, uptime ms, two 52-byte channel blocks (active, waveform, last result, clamp flags, disable reason, wave flags, steps, applied amplitude/offset, actual frequency, dwell, sequence, output and internal readback volts, update rate, table length playing, duty, phase, arbitrary length, CRC-32 of the table playing), then the uploaded-table block (state, length, upload id, expected and computed CRC, chunk bitmap).
types.name: DAQ_DAC_STATUS

types.doc: GS-only DAQ DAC arbitrary-table upload v1, exact 76 LE bytes: version, op (1 begin, 2 data, 3 commit, 4 clear), index u16 (begin/commit: length; data: first sample), upload id u32, value u32 (begin/commit: CRC-32; data: count), 32 x u16 DAC codes. The DAQ confirms through DAQ_DAC_STATUS.
types.name: DAQ_DAC_TABLE

types.doc: App-only manual query/recovery v1. Exact32LE bytes. Caller must supply exactly one explicit board endpoint; no broadcast default. Recovery requires current persisted boot generation, abort epoch, fresh primary request and issuer session.
types.name: BOARD_RECOVERY_REQUEST

types.doc: App-only recovery readback v1. Exact40LE bytes; echoed request nonce and issuer session, actual state/abort epoch and commanded GPIO/servo register mask. Not physical valve-position proof or protocolACK confirmation.
types.name: BOARD_STATE_STATUS

types.doc: Explicit application drive QUERY/SET v1; exact32LE. Address ACTUATOR_BOARD explicitly. SET binds original timestamp, boot generation, abort epoch, nonce and primary issuer.
types.name: AB_FILL_DRIVE_SETTINGS

types.doc: Actual actuator drive setting and nonblocking timed motion v1; exact40LE. Board confirmation is distinct from SDK delivery ACK and physical position verification.
types.name: AB_FILL_DRIVE_STATUS

types.doc: Actual accepted motion identity, lifecycle and monotonic minimum45 delay; separate exact56LE application status. Read-only QUERYv2 only; no mechanical position claim.
types.name: AB_FILL_MOTION_STATUS_V2

types.doc: Read-only igniter current-sense signal v1:12UInt32 words version,flags,boot generation lo/hi,source sequence,source uptime lo/hi,12-bit ADC counts,VDDA mV,sample age ms,reference age ms,hardware profile. Schematic045B5-on3V3 has no specified amperes conversion.
types.name: AB_IGNITER_SENSE

types.doc: Managed source: MCP3564R reference voltage in volts used to convert every MCP3564R code (1.9-2.6 V; nominal 2.4 V).
types.name: DAQ_MCP_REFERENCE
